html: The rooms have been reorganised. "Real-time Trade" and "Market View now" are merged into #相場実況 (Live Market), and "#移住届" is closed — introductions now happen in #広場 (The Square). Moving in opens three rooms: Live Market, Workshop and Economic News.

Switched to a free trial residency through 2026. No credit card registration is required. After the first week we decided it was only fair to let people see the inside before deciding. From January 1, 2027 it becomes ¥9,800/month (card registration required); we will explain again in December.
OKUGAI is fully open. Enrollment started at 00:00 today. The 6 a.m. daily market report has also begun.
Started logging systems 1–3 in the residents' record book (3 live accounts). Automatically compiled from trade data — win rate, profit and loss, and withdrawals, all shown as they are.
The hideout opened. Trial residency is now accepting applications — free through 2026, no card required.
